I'll never forget the day Bruno walked in to our small mom & pop shop here on Pico, offering his services as a web designer.  That was a good day.  Unlike the 100's of others who had previously come in offering the same thing over the last 15+ years, and god knows I needed someone for this very task, I knew right away Bruno was different and could work with him.  He was the first one I ever agreed to meet with again.
We decided to go with Bruno to build my new business website that was way overdue and in need, and after working many months with him I can honestly say it was the Best decision I ever made!
Not only do we have the most beautiful and professional new website up and running, but even more than that I think I appreciate how knowledgeable, how patient, how kind and generous he was been throughout the whole process. Every single thing he said he would do he did x10. No exaggeration.  He followed through on his word every time, something that can be hard to find in business dealings these days.
I'm a perfectionist, OCD to some degree, and so completing a task such as a new website has been a daunting one I avoided for far too long.  But having the right team by my side made it possible, and not only that but Bruno never made me feel like it was all to much, I'm sure more than he understood initially it would be working with me. Instead he always inspired me to keep going with confidence. I have made a great new friend in Bruno, but also someone I intend to continue working with in a business capacity for as long as we are in business (going on 77 years this year), for he has only proven to be a true asset in every single way possible.
We thank you Bruno, we love you, and we Truly appreciate you!
